edges.reason: onlyOwner compares msg.sender to the stored owner.
transferOwnership is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
msg.sender is used as the operator in the isCdpAllowed permission check.
msg.sender is used as the operator in the isCdpAllowed permission check.
AutomationBot.execute is gated by auth(msg.sender).
AutomationExecutor.execute is gated by auth(msg.sender).
AutomationExecutor.swap is gated by auth(msg.sender).
Executor transferOwnership is restricted to the owner.
addCaller is restricted to the owner.
getNextPrice requires whitelisted[msg.sender].
msg.sender is passed as sendTo so drawn DAI is delivered to the caller.
Computed gas refund is transferred back to msg.sender.
block.timestamp is used to schedule changes and enforce the required delay.
changeRequiredDelay can only be applied once the timestamp based delay elapses.
CloseCommand.execute delegates execution to the MPA contract address.
delegatecall returns control and arbitrary storage context to CloseCommand.execute.
execute makes an external call to the untrusted command contract before clearing the trigger.
The untrusted command regains control flow back into execute while the trigger record is still active.
execute temporarily grants cdpAllow to the command address around the external call.
drawDaiFromVault grants and then revokes CDP approval to McdUtils.
withdraw performs a low level ETH call to the owner.
The low level call returns control back into withdraw.
execute sends the miner bribe directly to block.coinbase.
execute sends the gas refund with transfer to msg.sender.
The refund transfer hands control to msg.sender, which could re-enter execute.
unwrapWETH calls the WETH contract withdraw function.
withdraw transfers ERC20 balances via safeTransfer.
swap uses SafeERC20 helpers that perform low level calls to the token.
drawDebt calls vat.hope and daiJoin.exit to release the drawn DAI.
TestWETH.withdraw updates balances and then transfers ETH to the caller.
execute calls drawDaiFromVault to cover the execution cost.
drawDaiFromVault calls utils.drawDebt on the McdUtils contract.
drawDebt calls _getDrawDart to compute the normalized debt.
removeTrigger may call changeApprovalStatus to revoke approval.
grantApproval routes through changeApprovalStatus.
transferOwnership is wrapped by the delayedExecution modifier.
changeRequiredDelay is wrapped by the delayedExecution modifier.
addNamedService is wrapped by the delayedExecution modifier.
updateNamedService is wrapped by the delayedExecution modifier.
execute uses the auth modifier to validate the executor.
executor execute uses the auth modifier.
swap uses the auth modifier.
addTrigger requires delegatecall context via onlyDelegate.
removeTrigger requires delegatecall context via onlyDelegate.
auth resolves the AUTOMATION_EXECUTOR address from the service registry.
The executor forwards the call to AutomationBot.execute.
validatePermissions calls isCdpAllowed.
changeApprovalStatus calls validatePermissions before mutating approvals.
addRecord calls isCdpAllowed to authorize the trigger registration.
removeRecord calls isCdpAllowed to authorize the trigger removal.
addRecord computes the trigger hash from the supplied data.
execute and isExecutionLegal decode the same trigger data layout.
DummyCommand.execute relies on the initial legal-check flag.
clearScheduledExecution enforces an exact calldata length.
transferOwnership enforces an exact calldata length.
transferOwnership overwrites the registry owner.
Executor transferOwnership updates the owner state variable.
withdraw sends ETH or tokens to the owner address.
addRecord increments triggersCounter.
addRecord writes the new TriggerRecord into activeTriggers.
execute clears activeTriggers[triggerId] after the external call.
delayedExecution reads and writes lastExecuted to gate the operation.
delayedExecution reads requiredDelay to define the waiting period.
changeRequiredDelay updates the requiredDelay state variable.
addNamedService writes the namedService mapping.
removeNamedService clears the namedService mapping entry.
addCaller writes the callers mapping.
removeCaller writes the callers mapping.
auth reads the callers mapping for authorization.
swap uses the configured exchange address for routing.
getNextPrice checks the whitelisted mapping before returning oracle data.
